name: v1.1
body:
## Changes in v1.1

- Fix shift-click item linking to properly format hyperlinks in chat
- Fix item ID extraction for AtlasLoot set items with 's' prefix
- Add One-Hand weapon slot for INVTYPE_WEAPON items
- Add support for AtlasLoot Tier Sets and container items
- Fix Lua 5.0 compatibility issue with string.match
- Integrate minimap with pfUI and add empty state UI
